messages:
sarah: quick heads up — planning a schema tweak to console_telemetry to add 'quota_sample_window' and 'route_quota_snapshot' fields. Need a migration approach that keeps dashboard queries fast and avoids huge backfill costs. Thoughts?
jordan: +1. what's the intended shape — denorm columns or a JSONB blob? if denorm we can index for p99 dashboards but cost is higher on writes.
ravi: i'd prefer denorm for hot path metrics (dashboards/alerts) and keep a compact envelope for cold storage. main worry is backfill compute and dual-write lag/consistency.
maya: what if we dual-write for a short period and run an incremental backfill for historical ranges, with a canary on 10% tenants first?
sarah: rough plan idea: 1) add new nullable columns so old reads still work, 2) deploy dual-write ingest behind a feature flag for 2 weeks, 3) run partitioned backfill that uses sampling windows to cap compute, 4) cutover when parity checks pass and error delta < 0.1%.
jordan: sampling windows — can you explain the sampler? i was thinking store per-route sampled snapshots every minute rather than per-event snapshots. that would drop QPS for dashboard queries dramatically.
ravi: sample sketch (pseudo):
```
# pseudo-sampling
if rand() < sampling_rate:
  write(route_quota_snapshot)
else:
  write(compact_envelope)
```
but we risk missing short spikes if sampling_rate is static.
maya: agree — use adaptive sampling: raise sampling_rate for routes with active quota alerts or when p50->p99 divergence exceeds threshold. that keeps signal for trouble spots.
eng-bot: deploy-bot: note created: rollout job template 'quota-sample-canary' will be available after PR merge.
sarah: ops notes: backfill jobs must be throttled, resumeable, and partitioned (hourly). console needs a toggle to view pre-cutover vs post-cutover data so product can validate.
jordan: from query side, plan to add composite index on (tenant_id, route_id, minute_bucket) and a read-adapter that can synthesize short-term snapshots by replaying KV cache for missing minutes. that keeps dashboard latency acceptable.
ravi: tentative migration checklist (rough):
- add nullable columns to console_telemetry schema
- ingest dual-write behind feature flag + rollout plan
- canary at 10% tenants -> 25% -> 100%
- backfill job (throttled + resume) that writes into hourly partitions using sampling windows
- read-adapter parity tests + synthetic evals against staging dashboards
- final cutover and cleanup of legacy fields
maya: also add an automated eval alert: if dashboard metric delta across canary > 2% we auto-hold/rollback. want to avoid silent regressions.
sarah: i'll draft a runbook with the steps and failure modes. @jordan can you own the index cost estimate and query perf tests? @ravi can you sketch the backfill DAG and throttling parameters? i'll open the PR tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
jordan: can do — will post cost numbers and estimated index size by EOD.
ravi: i'll prototype the backfill DAG (airflow + rate limiter) and post to #eng-infra for review.
maya: LGTM, thanks.
